title: International Society of Sports Nutrition position stand: nutrient timing
publisher: Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition
claims: The timing and amount of carbohydrate intake around exercise can affect performance and recovery.
Nutrient-timing recommendations should accommodate a wide range of individuals and be adjusted to exercise duration.
Carbohydrate availability is relevant to prolonged endurance exercise.

verification.note: J Int Soc Sports Nutr 2017;14:33 全文可读。

claimVerification.note: Position statement 第 1 条与 Background 均写碳水时机影响恢复与糖原再合成。
全文有 “recommendations must capture the needs of a wide range of individuals” 与按时长调整；未同时涵盖“整体膳食”，已删除该并列项。
Background："glycogen stores… predominant source of fuel for up to a few hours"；Practical applications 写 >60-90 分钟依赖内源碳水。
